title: Ordinary diagonal tensor on condensed internal actions
statement: Use the actual sectionwise internal action categories over a commutative condensed ring $R$ and an arbitrary topological group $J$ from [def-sfb-condensed-derived-invariants]. Equip actions with the ordinary relative internal-module tensor, with diagonal action $j(x\otimes y)=jx\otimes jy$ on every generalized pure tensor. The forgetful functor has the canonical strong tensor comparison, the symmetry is the ordinary factor exchange under this comparison, and the unit is the trivial regular module. The tensor is additive and closed, with conjugation action on internal Hom. Use functorial flat resolutions on the action site. Trivial inflation has the canonical strong tensor comparison whose underlying module maps are the tensor and regular-unit identities. It preserves colimits. Small colimits on both module categories are those of their Grothendieck structures.
